question_text: An alkylsulfonic acid surfactant with a C12 chain has measured CMC values of 7.8 mM at 30.0 C, 10.2 mM at 50.0 C, and 13.0 mM at 70.0 C. State both values, then say whether they are reasonably CONSISTENT with each other (implying a well-behaved, roughly linear van't Hoff relation over this range) or INCONSISTENT (implying real curvature/heat-capacity effects the two-point estimate can't capture).
